sections.title: Right now
lines: Pregame build, kickoff 3:25pm CT. Sold 630, 1,122 resting. Worst line -$115 (goal -$50).

sections.title: Next wave of contracts
lines: A side gets a new batch when its resting drops under 25% of launch.
Gate open: worst line -$115 is better than -$200.

sections.title: Tightening
lines: Backstop off. It trips if the worst line falls under -$100.
Paid balancing starts 3:05pm CT: worst line to -$50 by 3:20pm CT, up to $100.
At 2:55pm CT, if worst line is -$150 or better, paid balancing stops.
Kickoff 3:25pm CT: the in-game engine takes over.

sections.title: Will it adapt on its own?
lines: Mostly yes: price steps, new batches and paid balancing run by rule. It will not reprice for line moves or news.

next_steps.detail: Paid balancing stops if worst line is -$150 or better.
